General Interpretation of AUROC Scores:

-   AUROC = 1: Perfect classifier or perfect similarity between the clusters (i.e., the two clusters are identical or highly similar).

-   AUROC = 0.5: No better than random guessing (i.e., the two clusters have no similarity, they are as similar as randomly chosen clusters).

-   AUROC \< 0.5: This indicates anti-similarity, which means that the two clusters are inversely related (i.e., one cluster may have high expression for genes where the other has low expression, and vice versa).

-   <https://www.nature.com/articles/s41467-018-03282-0>

```{r}
library(Seurat)
set.seed(805181) ## for repeatability of cluster mapping.

load("R4_6.3_KC_only_processed.Rdata")
KC_only_processed-> selected_kc
```

## 11- [MetaNeighbor] Install data and R functions

```{r}
library(gplots)
library(RColorBrewer)
```

### 11.1- prepare the data for MetaNeighbor

-   the SummarizedExperiment and [`SingleCellExperiment`](https://bioconductor.org/packages/release/bioc/html/SingleCellExperiment.html)`is interchangeable.`

```{r}
library(MetaNeighbor) 
# devtools::install_git('https://github.com/gillislab/MetaNeighbor')
library(SummarizedExperiment)

library(scater)
# install loomR from GitHub using the remotes package remotes::install_github(repo =
# 'mojaveazure/loomR', ref = 'develop')
library(loomR)
library(Seurat)
library(patchwork)

kc.sce <- as.SingleCellExperiment(selected_kc,
                                   assay="RNA") # done
```

## 12- Identify a highly variable gene set

```{r}
var_genes = variableGenes(dat = kc.sce, 
                          exp_labels = kc.sce$study) 
head(var_genes) # 2250 genes.
```

## 13-Run Unsupervised MetaNeighbor

```{r}
celltype_NV = MetaNeighborUS(var_genes = var_genes, 
                             dat = kc.sce, 
                             study_id = kc.sce$study, 
                             cell_type = kc.sce$cell_type_0.7)

# save
save(celltype_NV, file = "R5_13_celltype_NV_metaneighbor.Rdata")

load("R5_13_celltype_NV_metaneighbor.Rdata")
```

## 14-Plot results

```{r}
cols= rev(colorRampPalette(RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(11,"RdBu"))(100))

breaks = seq(0, 1, length=101) 

# save plot
pdf("R5_14_metaneighbor_plot.pdf", width = 10, height = 10)
gplots::heatmap.2(celltype_NV, 
                 margins = c(8, 8), 
                 keysize = 1, 
                 key.xlab = "", 
                 key.title = "AUROC", 
                 trace = "none", 
                 density.info = "none", 
                 col = cols,
                 breaks = breaks, 
                 offsetRow = 0.1, 
                 offsetCol = 0.1, 
                 cexRow = 0.8,  # size of the row labels
                 cexCol = 0.8, # size of the col labels
lmat = rbind(c(4, 3), c(2, 1)),  # Layout for color key and heatmap
                 lhei = c(0.6, 4),  # Adjust the height of the color key (first value)
                 lwid = c(1.5, 5))  # Adjust the width of row dendrogram and heatmap
dev.off()

```

## 15- Identify reciprocal tophits and high scoring celltype pairs

```{r}
## To find reciprocal tophits and those with AUROC>0.9
top_hits_0.7 = topHits(cell_NV=celltype_NV, 
                  dat=kc.sce, 
                  study_id=kc.sce$study, 
                  cell_type=kc.sce$cell_type_0.7, 
                  threshold=0.7)

# save the top hit result.
library(openxlsx)
write.xlsx(top_hits_0.7,"R5_15_top_hits_auroc_0.7.xlsx") 
```

## B- similarity of big groups

### 1-Add new group annotation

```{r}
#> prepare the data for similarity analysis
library(Seurat)
set.seed(805181) ## for repeatability of cluster mapping.

load("R4_6.3_KC_only_processed.Rdata")
KC_only_processed-> selected_kc

#> add the group annotation [BAS/SPN/GRN]
cluster_number = names(table(selected_kc@meta.data$cell_type_0.7))

cluster_number
  ## [1] "BAS-I"   "BAS-II"  "BAS-III" "BAS-IV"  "BAS-V"   "SPN-I"   "SPN-II"  "SPN-III" "SPN-IV" 
  ## [10] "GRN-I"   "GRN-II"  "GRN-III"

annotation_cluster = c(rep("BAS",5),
                       rep("SPN",4),
                       rep("GRN",3))

cluster_anno = data.frame(cluster_number, annotation_cluster, stringsAsFactors = F)

selected_kc@meta.data$group = "NA" # define 'group'

for(i in 1:nrow(cluster_anno)) { 
selected_kc@meta.data[which(selected_kc@meta.data$cell_type_0.7 == cluster_anno$cluster_number[i]),'group'] <- cluster_anno$annotation_cluster[i] 
}

table(selected_kc$group) # check new annotation
    ##  BAS  GRN  SPN 
    ## 8002 4615 8488 


#> SAVE THE new object\
selected_kc-> new_annotated_kc
save(new_annotated_kc,file = "R5_B_new_annotated_kc.Rdata")
```

### 2- similarity calculation

```{r}

                                   assay="RNA") # done

var_genes = variableGenes(dat = kc.sce, 
                          exp_labels = kc.sce$study) 
head(var_genes) # 2557 genes.

celltype_NV = MetaNeighborUS(var_genes = var_genes,

# save
save(celltype_NV, file = "R5_B_2_celltype_NV_metaneighbor.Rdata")
```
